name: Sovereign Street
desc1: This is a cobblestoned street. It is dimly lit by guttering lanterns
desc2: hung from tall posts, and continues to the north and south. This
desc3: street is clean and well-kept, and banners hung from the posts flutter
desc4: gaily in the breeze. There is a small shop to the west with a
desc5: beautifully-carved door, and the sign hanging from over it sports the
desc6: word "Jeweller" in a bold hand. The entrance to a stables stands to
desc7: the east, definable by the unmistakable odour of horses.
